This is why it is so essential to understand just what Russia's interests in the Arctic actually are, rather than presuming motives that imperil cooperation and risk raising the stakes of doing business in the region. There is more evidence of success in Canada-Russia Arctic relations than in Russia-West relations in general. But instead of raising alarm bells about not doing enough to securitize the Arctic, we should instead consider embracing this success as a model for future engagement.
